name: Octree-based 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Towards Consistent Real-time Rendering with LOD-Structured 3D Gaussians
definition: Uses an octree-like tree of clusters; renders only the relevant LoD; achieves 99% reduction at far distances.
summary: Octree-based 3D Gaussian Splatting is a hierarchical method that organizes Gaussian primitives into a sparse octree to enable consistent, real-time rendering of large-scale scenes with reduced memory and computational costs.
